subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses initial and final consonant blends to build and break down words (bl-a-ck, bri-ng)

show.line: Two sounds stuck together! b-l. Black, blue, block. s-t. Stop, star, nest!

rounds.prompt: Listen. b-l. Which picture starts with b-l?
Listen. f-l-a-g. Put the sounds together. What word is it?
Listen. s-t. Which picture starts with s-t?
Listen. d-r-u-m. Put the sounds together. Say the word.
Which picture ends with s-t? Nest, or net?
Which picture ends with n-g, like ring?
Starts with b-l, or starts with s-t? Put each picture in its group.

hints: Say the two sounds fast, so they stick together.
Stretch the word out slowly. Listen to the first two sounds.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will put these sounds together. s-t-o-p.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! s-t-o-p says stop. Spot has the sounds in a different order.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say the sounds together. s-t-o-p. Stop!

parent_line: Can put two consonant sounds together at the start or end of a word.
